reviews.text: Thanks to Patricia, I was able to get away for a few days, entrusting her with the care and affection of Missi and Violeta. She takes care of our kittens as well as she does of us humans. If anyone is in the same situation as me, unable to leave their cats for a few days, I hope my experience helps. Trust Patricia. She's wonderful; after just a few days, the cats know her and are very comfortable. Thank you so much, Patricia; this is just the beginning.

Patricia is the best person we could have chosen to care for our cats, Zafira and Azabache. She inspired confidence in us from the very first moment, and the way she treated our furry friends was fabulous. Attentive, understanding, and absolutely lovely, she was a wonderful companion throughout. We are very, very happy.

Patricia came to look after my three cats, Koba, Andy, and Roma, during my vacation, and I couldn't be happier.

When I left, I was quite anxious about leaving them, but from the very first day, she put me at ease. She cared for them and knew how to respond to each of their needs. Because every cat has her own personality, habits, and quirks, and she understood and adapted to all three of them from day one.

For me, it was wonderful to be able to enjoy my vacation knowing they were in such good hands. You can tell when someone cares for animals with love, attention, and genuine dedication, and that's exactly what I found in Patricia.

I have no doubt that I'll use her again for my next vacation (if Patricia wants to, of course 😊) and whenever I need help taking care of my cats.

Thank you, Patricia! 🥰

Patricia is, without a doubt, the best person to keep Oreo company! She gives us, and him too, a lot of security and confidence. Oreo has grown very fond of her, enjoys spending time with her, and feels like himself. We couldn't be happier to have found her. Thank you for your great work! 😘
Patricia has been taking care of my cats for two years now when I travel, and I feel completely at ease. My three cats adore her and have a wonderful time with her. I highly recommend her.

Patri has been taking care of my cats for over four years now… and I can only say good things about her.

And it's not just my opinion, but also Lilith and Moon's, who adore Patri, even though they're a bit skittish. The time she's with them is super active; she stimulates them a lot, and they stay calm the rest of the day they spend on their own. Plus, Patri is incredibly helpful if you need anything specific. She's the reason I can go away, whether for work or leisure, without worry.

Patricia is wonderful. She took care of Croqueta when she was little, and I'll always be grateful to her. She has a special sensitivity towards animals and incredible knowledge. You can tell she loves what she does, and she inspires a lot of confidence. Highly recommended.

Patricia is, without a doubt, our 100% trusted cat sitter. She's always attentive, professional, affectionate, and incredibly dedicated to the care of our cats. They adore her, and that's no small feat: she knows how to earn that selective feline trust with patience and affection, a trust that's so difficult to win 🐈.

Her presence gives us enormous peace of mind whenever we're not home. She keeps us informed, advises us, attends to every detail, and helps us with everything that comes up. For us, there's no one better. We wholeheartedly recommend her.
Patricia is wonderful with our kittens. We've been using her services for a long time now, and it saves us unnecessary trips. I highly recommend her services ☺️

I want to leave a very, very positive review about Patricia, because she has been a key figure in integrating and improving the coexistence of my three cats.

From the very first moment, she has demonstrated infinite patience, great empathy, and a huge heart. She has always been there for us with warmth, understanding, and respect, both for us and for our cats. She has not only helped us, but has also taught us so much, providing us with countless practical tools and tricks.

Patricia has extensive knowledge of feline behavior, Bach flower remedies, among other disciplines, and has been a fundamental support throughout the entire process.

Our situation was anything but easy. I never would have imagined that my three cats could live together in harmony. The relationship between Milo and Bimba was already very delicate, and with the arrival of Lola—with all her energy and also many fears—everything became even more unstable. We have experienced truly difficult situations, including episodes of redirected aggression caused by emotional outbursts, fear, or panic in some of them.

Patricia has always been there to help us, always with a solution, a calm demeanor, and clear guidance. She's also been able to downplay behaviors I perceived as fights, helping me better understand feline language and see my cats in a new light.

Thanks to her support, today I can see my three cats together in barely a square meter… and even, on occasion, licking each other. Something absolutely unthinkable for me, something I never would have imagined in my wildest dreams.

There are still a few minor details to refine—because this is a process and takes time—but Patricia has consistently provided us with the support, reassurance, and tools we need to move forward with confidence.

I can only express my deepest gratitude for her work and wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone going through a difficult situation with their cats. With Patricia, you're in the best hands 🐾💛

You can already see how my cats are able to sleep together in a small space, or simply close to each other in the kitchen. You can see how they're becoming more and more involved.

They also taught me how to play hunting games with Lola, quieter games as you can see in the videos.

It's incredible that all three of them will lie down in the same spot without any conflict. I'm so touched ❤️
